baseline_models.focus_anchor: قاصرات الطرف at words 2-3 is an active-participle construction whose restriction falls on الطرف.
baseline_models.mechanism: The women act as setters of a visual limit: restriction and sufficiency in ق ص ر combine with glance and endpoint in ط ر ف. The gaze is bounded because it has a sufficient terminus, not because the women are inertly enclosed.

activation_trace.role: Restriction to one object supplies the women's active control of visual attention.
A reached limit that suffices turns restraint into settled enoughness rather than deprivation.
The eye's glance supplies the literal faculty being deliberately governed.
An edge or endpoint makes the gaze a bounded field with a chosen terminus.

changed_reading.before: Women characterized simply by lowered or modest eyes.
changed_reading.after: Women exercising visual agency by setting a sufficient endpoint to their attention.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated prior-contact clause at words 4-9 names both إنس and جان and marks anteriority with قبلهم.
baseline_models.mechanism: Human appearance and sensory apprehension stand opposite jann concealment. Naming both poles closes the relational past across agents who are manifest and agents who evade perception; the untouched state is total privacy, not merely absence of a known human predecessor.

activation_trace.role: The manifest human, explicitly contrasted with jinn, supplies the visible pole of possible prior agents.
Sensory apprehension broadens the visible pole from social identity to detectable encounter.
Concealment supplies the unseen pole and makes the privacy claim cross perceptual boundaries.
Hidden jinn identify the second named class as genuinely imperceptible agents rather than rhetorical excess.
Temporal precedence turns visible-hidden coverage into a claim about the whole prior history.

changed_reading.before: No identifiable human had previously touched them.
changed_reading.after: No manifest or hidden agent occupies their prior relational history; privacy spans the perceptible and imperceptible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قاصرات الطرف and قبلهم place restricted attention beside a root that can express facing and willing reception.
baseline_models.mechanism: Special restriction in ق ص ر and the return of ط ر ف combine with facing and acceptance in ق ب ل. The gaze is not extinguished: it withdraws from diffuse edges and becomes available to a particular counterpart.

activation_trace.role: Special restriction and nearness supply attention reserved for a particular relation.
Turning the edge back supplies a dynamic redirection of sight rather than blank aversion.
Face-to-face orientation supplies a counterpart toward whom bounded attention can turn.
Willing acceptance keeps the facing relation receptive rather than coercive.

changed_reading.before: Their gaze is merely averted from everyone.
changed_reading.after: Their gaze is selectively redirected into receptive, face-to-face sufficiency with a counterpart.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening moves through womb-like protection, gathering a pregnancy, and origination. Applied to the focus's anterior negation, these cues make absence of a predecessor an origin condition: the companions enter as newly originated lives with no inherited embodied claim upon them.

activation_trace.role: Precedence supplies the focus's explicit backward-looking axis.
Fresh beginning supplies a latent inaugural sense inside the focus's final named root.
The female womb supplies protected generation rather than ownership as the first context frame.
A womb gathering a pregnancy adds formation by interior collection.
Origination supplies the causal event that can begin without a prior claimant.

structural_cues: The focus binds negation to anterior time through لم ... قبلهم; its ط م ث occurrence at word 5 has no branch inventory and is used only as the bodily-contact hinge.
55:14-15 repeat creation for the same human/jann polarity that closes the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies generation, origination, anteriority, and the repeated human/jann pair; I supply the arrow from created beginning to a predecessor-free embodied history. The ordinary virginity reading remains live and may be the narrower alternative.

changed_reading.after: Untouchedness also marks unprecedented origin: these lives arrive without an inherited embodied past or prior claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: Calculated celestial motion opens into a scale, prohibition of exceeding its limit, and equitable calibration. That sequence activates قاصرات الطرف as the intimate-scale version of the same regulator: desire and sight retain motion while refusing excess.

activation_trace.role: Limit and sufficiency make the focus capable of carrying calibrated restraint.
The visual edge supplies the local boundary at which calibration operates.
Counting and calculation supply ordered motion rather than stasis.
Balancing two things supplies a relational measure for the gaze.
Exceeding the limit in rebellion identifies overreach as the failure the boundary prevents.
Equity makes restraint an ethical proportion rather than imposed diminishment.

structural_cues: 55:5-9 moves from calculated paired motion to a repeatedly named scale, then forbids excess and loss.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calculation, balance, limit violation, and equity; I infer that the same control logic is miniaturized in the focus's visual construction. A live alternative is that the two passages share only a general praise of order.

changed_reading.before: The held gaze is a private convention of modesty.
changed_reading.after: The held gaze is ethical self-measurement, an intimate analogue of cosmic and social balance that prevents visual overreach.

context_deltas.mechanism: A branch of سجود directly joins sustained looking with a softened, lowered gaze. It activates قاصرات الطرف as an embodied act of submission continuous with the star and tree's prostration, while preserving the interpersonal reading beside it.

activation_trace.role: Holding back supplies the deliberate restraint that can become a bodily devotional posture.
The glance supplies the exact bodily faculty affected by the prostration branch.
Sustained looking with a languid gaze supplies an ocular realization of prostration.

structural_cues: 55:6 predicates a dual act of prostration of star and tree before the focus later depicts a deliberately bounded gaze.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a prostration branch already expressed through the gaze; I infer continuity between cosmic submission and the focus's ocular posture. The alternative is that this rare branch sense should remain lexical resonance, not scene-level mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Their eyes perform only interpersonal modesty.
changed_reading.after: Their bounded eyes can also enact sajda, placing intimacy inside the surah's wider choreography of submission.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two expanses meet, a between-space keeps them from overrunning one another, and something precious emerges. This hydrological mechanism changes the focus's limits from static seclusion into a productive interface: intimacy can involve meeting while preserving non-violation.

activation_trace.role: Restriction supplies the focus-side boundary that prevents one party from overrunning another.
The edge supplies an interface rather than an isolating wall.
A connection standing between two parties supplies a boundary that relates while separating.
Two counterparts arriving together supplies real encounter across the interface.
Aggressive boundary-crossing names the overrun explicitly refused by the scene.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies emergence as the result of bounded meeting.
The pearl supplies the precious product of contact without collapse.

structural_cues: 55:19-22 sequences meeting, a between-boundary, non-overrun, and emergence; the focus likewise combines bounded sight with negated prior bodily contact.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies meeting, relational separation, refused overrun, and precious emergence; I map that causal sequence onto intimate boundaries in the focus. The alternative is a material analogy with no intended interpersonal transfer.

changed_reading.before: Purity is preserved by never meeting another.
changed_reading.after: Integrity is preserved through a boundary that permits encounter without overrun and can make relation generative.

context_deltas.mechanism: Universal passing-away is opposed to what remains, then each temporal unit carries a fresh affair. Against that temporal architecture, قبلهم can mark more than ordinary sequence: the focus scene stands across a discontinuity where former embodied histories have ended and relation begins anew.

activation_trace.role: What precedes supplies the temporal history subjected to discontinuity.
Fresh beginning supplies the focus-side capacity for relation after a reset.
Cessation after duration supplies a hard end to the former order.
Continuance supplies the contrasting axis by which the new scene is not simple chronological continuation.
A bounded span of time supplies repeated temporal renewal.
A newly present affair supplies content for each renewed temporal span.

structural_cues: The focus's لم ... قبلهم is explicitly retrospective, while 55:26-29 stages ending, remaining, and recurring present action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal ending, persistence, recurring duration, and fresh affairs; I infer an eschatological break in relational history. A materially live alternative is that قبلهم remains ordinary prior-time language unaffected by this earlier sequence.

changed_reading.before: The clause denies an earlier partner within continuous biography.
changed_reading.after: The clause can mark a renewed order in which prior mortal histories no longer carry claims into the present relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact human/jinn pair is challenged to cross the regions of heaven and earth but cannot pass through except with effective authority. That access-control scene sharpens the focus's same pair and bodily non-contact: its boundary excludes both visible and hidden intrusion, rather than merely recording lack of opportunity.

activation_trace.role: Confining access to a designated object supplies an intimate perimeter.
The manifest human supplies one class barred from prior intrusion.
The hidden jinn supply the other class, closing an evasion route around the perimeter.
The same manifest-human class establishes an exact participant echo with the focus.
The same hidden-jinn class completes the echoed pair.
Passing cleanly to the far side supplies the attempted penetration of a bounded domain.
Regions and sides supply the perimeter across which passage is tested.
Effective authority supplies the sole condition under which a boundary may be crossed.

structural_cues: 55:33 and 55:56 uniquely foreground the same human/jinn dyad in scenes organized around passage or contact.
The uncitable ط م ث occurrence at 55:56 word 5 is used structurally as the bodily crossing that the focus negates.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated dyad, a perimeter, failed passage, and authority; I infer that the cosmic access rule models intimate non-intrusion. The alternative is that the dyad recurs only because it is the surah's standing audience.

changed_reading.before: No human or jinn happened to reach them earlier.
changed_reading.after: Their integrity behaves as an access-controlled domain that neither visible nor hidden agents may penetrate without rightful authorization.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby عين is a spring in the sentence but its inventory also carries the seeing eye; the springs actively flow. This bifurcation activates الطرف as a current of attention that ق ص ر channels and contains rather than stops.

activation_trace.role: Restraint supplies the channel that keeps visual movement within bounds.
The glance supplies the focus-side visual current.
The seeing eye supplies a latent visual face of the context noun.
A flowing water source supplies the noun's explicit garden realization and the current analogy.
Continuous flowing supplies movement, preventing bounded gaze from collapsing into lifeless immobility.

structural_cues: 55:50 places two actively flowing springs inside the same garden sequence that reaches the focus six verses later.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the eye/spring branch bifurcation and active flow; I infer a hydrological model for visual attention. The live alternative is that this is only a root-level pun with no causal force.

changed_reading.before: Restrained sight is static or extinguished.
changed_reading.after: Sight remains a living current, but one channeled toward a bounded relational field.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden sequence first pairs each kind, then states a face-to-face logic in which good action is answered by good action. Those cues revise selective gaze from unilateral female availability into reciprocal pairing: each party's directed attention and excellence meet an answering counterpart.

activation_trace.role: Special relational restriction supplies focused commitment to a counterpart.
Facing one another supplies reciprocity rather than one-directional display.
Intimacy that removes estrangement supplies the social outcome of mutual attention.
A counterpart joined to its counterpart supplies the garden's pairing architecture.
An act met by its answering recompense supplies the mechanism of reciprocity.
Good action repeated on both sides supplies the ethical content exchanged by the pair.

structural_cues: 55:52 organizes fruit as pairs, while 55:60 repeats إحسان on both sides of an answering construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired counterparts and action answered in kind; I infer that this relational grammar governs the companions rather than merely surrounding them. The alternative remains an asymmetrical reward scene in which reciprocity applies only to divine recompense.

changed_reading.before: The women are one-directional rewards whose gaze confirms possession.
changed_reading.after: They are participants in a reciprocal pair, directing and receiving attention within an answering economy of intimacy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later garden uses passive مقصورات with a locative tent phrase, then repeats the focus's prior-contact clause without repeating قاصرات الطرف. This controlled contrast separates active visual self-limitation in 55:56 from external spatial enclosure in 55:72.

activation_trace.role: Restriction in the active participle supplies self-directed control whose object is the gaze.
The glance names the object governed in the first construction.
The same restriction image appears passively and makes external confinement available for direct contrast.
Tent and dwelling supply the explicit location of the later passive confinement.
Repeated precedence confirms that the prior-history claim survives independently of either ق ص ر construction.

structural_cues: 55:56 has active قاصرات governing الطرف; 55:72 has passive مقصورات followed by في الخيام.
55:74 repeats the 55:56 prior-contact clause nearly verbatim; its ط م ث occurrence at word 2 is branchless and used only as structural repetition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared root, active/passive morphology, distinct complements, and repeated untouched clause; I infer that the contrast prevents collapsing active gaze-governance into spatial confinement. A live alternative is poetic variation that does not intentionally contrast agency.

changed_reading.before: قاصرات الطرف means women confined or kept from looking outward.
changed_reading.after: 55:56 foregrounds women actively governing their own gaze; external confinement is a separate later image with passive morphology and a stated location.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines branch-distant senses of three focus roots: present beginning, newness, and fresh inception. It remains anchored in قبلهم, الطرف, and جان themselves, but downstream prose should render it only as an inaugural resonance, never as a replacement gloss for the clause.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes prior time with roots that can carry a newly arrived thing and the freshness of a beginning.

activation_trace.role: An immediate, unprepared beginning supplies the scene's inaugural present.
Something newly occurring supplies novelty to the visual encounter.
Fresh inception supplies newness on the hidden-life pole.

changed_reading.before: Before marks only an earlier point on a continuous timeline.
changed_reading.after: The encounter can resonate as an unscripted first present, with no rehearsed predecessor.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The horticultural transfer is surprising and can objectify if literalized. It remains valid as a material analogy because the focus roots carry enclosure and hidden garden while the context moves from fruit-cover to harvest and nearness; downstream prose must call it protected maturation, not equate persons with produce.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قاصرات and جان can activate enclosed structure and concealed garden around the focus's negated prior-contact construction.

activation_trace.role: An enclosed structure supplies protected interior space around maturation.
A garden concealed by growth anchors the material analogy in a focus root.
A plant casing around its fruit supplies protection during formation.
Taking mature produce from its growth-place supplies readiness after protection.
Nearness supplies availability without requiring invasive seizure.

changed_reading.before: Seclusion is a static state maintained for possession.
changed_reading.after: A secondary material resonance presents integrity as protected maturation that reaches nearness without prior violation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because cloth-working and fabric-edge branches sit far from the ordinary human description. It remains anchored in both words of قاصرات الطرف and in the nearby beds, linings, tents, and hanging cover; downstream prose should keep it as a tactile undertone of hemmed boundaries and never turn the women into furnishings.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two roots in قاصرات الطرف contain cloth-finishing and tent-edge branches inside a furnishing-dense garden sequence.

activation_trace.role: Fulling or shortening cloth supplies the tactile act of finishing a boundary.
The edges of tent or cloth supply the literal hem on which the material resonance turns.
Spread bedding supplies the surrounding textile field.
A garment's inner lining supplies a valued concealed textile interior.
Tent and dwelling extend the bounded-fabric architecture later in the sequence.
A hanging edge or fluttering cover closes the sequence with another mobile textile boundary.

changed_reading.before: The phrase carries only an abstract moral quality of sight.
changed_reading.after: As a secondary tactile echo, the bounded gaze feels hemmed and finished within the garden's layered textile interiors.

strongest_changes: The later passive مقصورات في الخيام differentiates external enclosure from the active gaze-governance of قاصرات الطرف.
Calculation, balance, non-overrun, and authorized passage recast the focus as an ethics of boundaries rather than a purity inventory.
Pairing and answered excellence support reciprocal intimacy rather than one-directional possession.
Creation and temporal discontinuity keep an exploratory reading of predecessor-free origin alive beside ordinary sexual untouchedness.
summary.what_was_special: The same focus lexemes supported coexisting visual, spatial, temporal, hydrological, ritual, and reciprocal mechanisms, with the exact 55:72-74 parallel providing unusually strong control over which readings should remain distinct.
remaining_uncertainties: The central ط م ث root has no branch inventory, so its contribution can be used structurally but cannot discriminate among the activated mechanisms.
The cosmic-measure, sea-boundary, and eye-spring transfers may be deliberate mechanisms or reader-supplied analogies; their directional arrows remain abductive.
Fresh-beginning, maturation, and textile-edge readings depend on branch-distant senses and should remain secondary resonances.
The antecedent range of فيهن may affect how strongly spatial enclosure belongs to the focus itself.
